2026-09-25DFOFisheries ActRegulations Amending the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985Regulations Amending the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985 in order to (1) update the regulations by removing references and representations of the obsolete LFA 37 area and divide the area equitably between LFA 36 and LFA 38 along the same interim boundaries that have been in place through conditions of licence since the 2022-23 fishing season.Registration: SOR/2026-0199 Publication Date: 2026-10-07
subject: Regulations Amending the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985
precis: Regulations Amending the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985 in order to (1) update the regulations by removing references and representations of the obsolete LFA 37 area and divide the area equitably between LFA 36 and LFA 38 along the same interim boundaries that have been in place through conditions of licence since the 2022-23 fishing season.
